# Monitored_Quantum_Circuits

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
Quantum circuits interspersed with projective measurements that induce entanglement phase transitions between volume-law and area-law scaling. These circuits model the interplay between unitary evolution and measurement-induced collapse, relevant for designing robust quantum reservoirs and measurement-based neuromorphic processing.
